💎 Product Description
Crafted with premium hard enamel, this pin features a durable metal backing and a refined metal frame. The design honors the traditional Chinese "Auspicious Deer" (祥鹿), finished in a clean white enamel contrasted by shimmering golden metal detailing. Look closely, and you will see the deer adorned with flowing ribbons and swirling auspicious clouds, captured in a pose that suggests it is ready to leap forward. Its graceful lines and sophisticated color scheme make it a timeless piece of wearable art.
•	Size: Approx. 4.5 x 3.5 x 1 cm
🎁Perfect for Every Occasion
This unique, neo-Chinese style accessory is a meaningful and thoughtful gift for:
•	🎓 Graduations: Wishing for a bright, smooth journey into the future.
•	🚗 New Car Owners: An ideal gift to wish for safe travels and peace on the road.
•	🧧 Special Milestones: Perfect for your Ben Ming Nian (zodiac birth year).
•	🎁 Holidays: A wonderful gift for New Year, Mid-Autumn, or Spring Festival.
🎁 A Note of Surprise: Each set comes with a hand-selected, beautifully designed greeting card from our collection. Think of it as a little surprise—whichever card arrives with your pin is the one meant to share its unique, heartfelt message with you or your recipient.
Whether for friends, family, or someone special, this pin is a versatile fashion statement. Style it on your scarf, lapel, hat, or backpack—a subtle, chic detail that makes your outfit stand out. May your journey ahead be smooth and prosperous.
✈️Shipping & Usage Notes
•	Please Note: The package contains an enamel pin, a greeting card and two Chinese Landscape Stickers .
•	Shipping: We offer FREE shipping on all orders. We hope these beautiful blessings reach you soon.
